question: What vessel arrangement is required in pañcāyatana worship?
premises: The verse specifies the context of pañcāyatana worship.
It prescribes a fivefold set of five vessels beginning with arghya.
This extends the earlier vessel arrangement to five sets.
inference: In pañcāyatana worship, five sets of the five arghya-related vessels are required.
plain_english: In the worship of the five shrines, there should be five sets of the five vessels beginning with arghya.
